finding.claim: The cancel guard is inverted: on first cancel token.reason is falsy so `if (!token.reason) return` exits early and never sets reason or resolves the promise, so cancellation never takes effect.

verifier.reason: The guard at cancel/CancelToken.js:55 returns when token.reason is falsy, which is its initial unset state, so the assignments at cancel/CancelToken.js:60-61 are unreachable on first and subsequent cancels.

finding.claim: settle resolves any status <500 even when validateStatus returns false, so custom validateStatus and default 4xx rejection never reject.
